name: Pack of 2 | O’Mayln 24K Gold Firming Essence Mask 30ml | Skin Firming & Anti-Aging Treatment
description:
Indulge in luxury skincare with the O’Mayln 24K Gold Firming Essence Mask (30ml, Pack of 2) — a premium anti-aging treatment infused with real 24K gold and nourishing essence. Designed to tighten, lift, and rejuvenate, this mask reduces fine lines and wrinkles while boosting elasticity for a youthful glow.

Its deeply hydrating and smoothing formula enhances radiance and texture, leaving your skin firmer, brighter, and more luminous after every use.

Key Features:
Firms and tightens for youthful-looking skin
Reduces fine lines and improves elasticity
Deeply hydrates and nourishes for smooth texture
Restores natural glow and radiance
Perfect for anti-aging and skin rejuvenation

How to Use:
① Cleanse your face thoroughly.
② Apply an even layer of mask to your skin.
③ Leave on for 15–20 minutes, then remove gently.
④ Massage remaining essence until fully absorbed.
⑤ Use 2–3 times a week for best results.
